end.summary:
Defined food miles as the distance food travels from source to consumer.
Identified fuel use, pollution, freshness, and refrigeration costs linked to transport.
Suggested choosing local seasonal food to reduce food miles; gave mango as an example.
Teach-back was not passed; the child asked for labels and a kiwi picture that were not shown.
end.parentNote: Rohan practised defining food miles and explaining how transport can use fuel, increase pollution, and affect freshness. They used seasonal local mangoes as an example and gave two ways to reduce food miles. They also questioned whether imported food is better; later they stated that distance does not add nutrients, which corrected that mix-up. At home, ask them to explain the food miles of one food item and name one local or seasonal alternative.
